title: Let's talk Transformation #180 (Suzie Lewis) — 'Incorruptible: maximising human flourishing with Eric Ries'
summary: Suzie Lewis's business-leaders podcast releases a 41-minute Eric conversation on organisational soulcraft — mission guardians, PBC status, tenured board structures, and the argument that profit is best defined as the result of maximising human flourishing.
blockquote: The companies that last aren't the ones that avoid pressure. They're the ones that decided early what they would refuse to trade away.
